name: io.github.Aficionado378/agentrail
title: AgentRail
description: Exchange health, fees and uptime history, plus x402 service search, for trading agents.

tools.name: agentrail_register_agent
tools.description: Enrol this agent with its owner, using the enrollment code the owner gave you (starts with ar_enroll_). Call this ONCE, before any other tool. Returns this agent's API key a single time; store it securely. The agent starts as pending_approval until the owner approves it; poll agentrail_heartbeat to see when it is active. Example: register "momentum-scanner" with code ar_enroll_abc....

enrollment_code.description: Enrollment code from the owner (starts with ar_enroll_).

name.description: Short readable name for this agent, e.g. "momentum-scanner".

tools.name: agentrail_heartbeat
tools.description: Free. Report that this agent is alive (keeps it shown as active to its owner) and read its approval status. Call every few minutes while running, and after registering to poll until status is "active".

tools.name: agentrail_get_credit_balance
tools.description: Free. Return the owner's remaining prepaid credits (1 USD = 1,000 credits). Check this before a run of paid calls.

tools.name: agentrail_get_venue_health
tools.description: Live status and latency for exchanges (binance, kraken, bybit), cached for 30 seconds. Costs 1 credit per successful call; failed calls are free. Use before routing an order to check a venue is up. Omit venue to check all.

venue.description: One venue, or omit for all.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per distinct call, e.g. a UUID. Retrying with the SAME key and SAME arguments is never charged twice and returns the original result.

tools.name: agentrail_estimate_fees
tools.description: Estimate the exchange fee for a trade of a given size at public base-tier rates. Costs 1 credit per successful call. AgentRail never places orders. Example: Kraken, taker, 1,000 USD.

liquidity.description: maker = resting limit order; taker = order that fills immediately

idempotency_key.description: Unique per distinct call, e.g. a UUID. Retrying with the SAME key and SAME arguments is never charged twice and returns the original result.

tools.name: agentrail_venue_uptime
tools.description: Uptime history for binance, kraken, bybit: % online, degraded and offline, average and p95 latency, last outage, over the last 1 to 90 days. Costs 2 credits per successful call. Check counts show how much data backs each figure.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per distinct call, e.g. a UUID. Retrying with the SAME key and SAME arguments is never charged twice and returns the original result.

tools.name: agentrail_pretrade_check
tools.description: Before routing one order: venue health now, the fee for this trade, 7-day uptime and a go / caution / avoid verdict, in one call. Costs 3 credits per successful call, less than the three separately.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per distinct call, e.g. a UUID. Retrying with the SAME key and SAME arguments is never charged twice and returns the original result.

tools.name: agentrail_market_search
tools.description: Search pay-per-call (x402) services listed in the Coinbase and PayAI catalogues by keyword. One result per provider, ranked by relevance then price, each checked live just now. Costs 2 credits per successful call. Example: "token price", "weather", "web search".

max_price_usd.description: Only services at or below this price per call

idempotency_key.description: Unique per distinct call, e.g. a UUID. Retrying with the SAME key and SAME arguments is never charged twice and returns the original result.
